dishes.name: Gratin dauphinois
dishes.desc: Thin potato slices baked slowly in cream and garlic, traditionally without cheese. The classic dish of the Dauphiné.

dishes.name: Grenoble walnut tart
dishes.desc: Tart of Grenoble walnuts, brown sugar, butter and fresh cream. Grenoble walnuts hold an AOP, France's first for a dried fruit, and pâtisseries across Isère sell the tart.

dishes.name: Bleu du Vercors-Sassenage
dishes.desc: Mild protected blue cheese from the cows that graze in the Vercors Natural Park, just above Grenoble.

dishes.name: Saint-Marcellin
dishes.desc: Small soft cow's milk cheese with a protected geographical indication, produced in Isère and neighbouring departments and a fixture of Grenoble markets.

dishes.name: Murçon
dishes.desc: Cooked pork sausage seasoned with caraway, tied to the Matheysine area south of Grenoble around La Mure.
